title: delta-credit-sanitizer-and-session-fingerprint-imputer-for-retro-billing-corrections
creator: Priya Patel
description: Problem: We periodically discover late-arriving or misattributed token events that cause incorrect tenant credits/charges. Existing reconciliation jobs (windowed rollups) are conservative and either leave orphaned tokens unaccounted or apply bulk true-ups that are noisy for tenants. This ticket implements a safe, idempotent 'delta credit sanitizer' pipeline that (1) fingerprints session groups, (2) imputes probable missing events with confidence scores, (3) computes per-tenant delta adjustments, and (4) stages corrections as non-destructive ledger deltas for operator review and controlled dispatch.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline computes deterministic session fingerprints for >99.9% of historic events in test dataset
Imputation produces confidence score per adjustment and supports configurable cutoff; default cutoff = 0.75
Generated delta adjustments appear in a staging ledger topic and never mutate historical invoices without manual approval
Canary run (10 tenants) applied as soft credits; downstream billing/chargeback flows consume staged deltas and show zero net-change unless explicitly approved
End-to-end latency for daily batch run <= 45 minutes for 10M events, with job retry/backoff and idempotent sinks
Observability: per-tenant preview dashboard, daily diff report, and alert when adjustments exceed 1% of monthly billed tokens for any tenant
updates: 2026-02-12: Spike completed — evaluated three fingerprint strategies (header-hash, sliding-window request-seq, probabilistic sketch). Chose hybrid: stable header-hash + sliding-window for close joins.

2026-02-20: Proto pipeline implemented in data-lab (spark) using deterministic hashing and TTL-based tombstones. Initial imputation algorithm uses last-observed route proportions to split ambiguous tokens.
2026-02-27: Design review with PM and billing team. Decided on staging ledger topic (topic: staged-delta-credits-v1) and operator approval flow in Console (manual approve + scheduled bulk apply).
2026-03-04: Added confidence scoring and metadata (reason codes) to deltas. Began instrumenting preview dashboard (Grafana panel + per-tenant CSV export).
2026-03-10: Integration tests added for idempotency — re-running the job against the same inputs yields no duplicate adjustments. Added backfill mode flag and dry-run mode for canary tenants.

2026-03-12: Started canary with 12 tenants (billing team notified). Early results show 0.18% average monthly delta per tenant; one tenant flagged at 2.6% and triaged for manual review (ticket: PM-1229).
technical_notes: Fingerprint: sha256(base_headers_norm + client_id + session_start_bucket) truncated to 64 bits to fit our shard-key constraints
Imputation: Bayesian proportional splitter that redistributes ambiguous tokens based on a tenant's recent route distribution and sequence alignment confidence
Idempotency: sink writes include deterministic delta_id = sha256(fingerprint + window_start + change_hash) and tombstone marker to avoid double-apply
Storage: intermediate materialized view stored in bigquery (partitioned by day) and compacted snapshots in S3 for replay
Canary: support tenant allowlist file and dry-run flag; write-only to staging Kafka topic until operator promotes
Failure modes: if downstream ledger apply fails, we mark adjustments as 'pending' and retry with exponential backoff. Alerts fire on 4 consecutive failures per tenant.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives causing incorrect credits. Mitigation: confidence cutoff, manual approval gate, and per-tenant preview + audit trail.
Risk: Performance regression on daily window. Mitigation: parallelized Spark stage, adaptive partitioning, and a lightweight fast-path for small tenants.
Risk: Ledger corruption. Mitigation: staged non-destructive deltas + idempotent apply + operator rollback path and reconciliation job.
qa_plan: Unit tests for fingerprint and imputation logic with synthetic sequences
Integration test against staging ledger with canary tenants (dry-run) verifying no invoices change
Load test: 50M events/day profile in sandbox, verify job completes within SLA and memory bounds
Audit: Post-run diff validator compares re-run deltas to initial run and flags any divergence > 0.01%
next_steps: Finish canary run and gather tenant feedback (due 2026-03-18)
Wire operator approve flow in Console and add audit log export
Schedule release window for console-2026.03 and coordinate with billing ops for initial manual applies
Post-release: create automated daily validator and add to SLO dashboard
